info.title: SharpAI Server API
info.description: Local AI inference server with Ollama- and OpenAI-compatible REST endpoints. Provides model management, embeddings, completions, and chat completions against locally hosted GGUF models via LlamaSharp. The OpenAPI document at /openapi.json and the Swagger UI at /swagger require bearer authentication.

post.summary: Log in and create a session token
post.description: Validates an email/password login and, on success, returns an opaque bearer token that references a revocable server-side session. Supply credentials in the x-email, x-password, and optional x-tenant-guid headers (the 'default' tenant is used when omitted). This endpoint is anonymous so it is reachable without a prior credential.

get.description: Returns details of the session referenced by the supplied bearer token (Authorization: Bearer).

delete.description: Revokes (logs out) the session referenced by the supplied bearer token. The token is immediately invalid.

get.description: Paginated list of security audit events (authentication failures and privileged operations). Requires administrator or tenant-administrator privileges. Global administrators may scope with the tenantGuid query parameter; tenant administrators are constrained to their tenant.

Returns the computed effective permission set for a user within a tenant, as (resourceType, operation, effect, scope, resourceGuid) grants. Requires Admin on the Admin resource, or the principal reading their own permissions.
Returns the computed effective permission set for a credential within a tenant. Requires Admin on the Admin resource, or the credential's owner reading its own permissions.
Returns a single tenant. Callers are constrained to their own tenant unless they are platform administrators.

delete.description: Deletes a tenant. Protected tenants cannot be deleted. Requires platform-administrator (Admin) privileges.

get.description: Returns a single user (password hash redacted).

delete.description: Deletes a user and cascades to their credentials and role assignments. Protected users cannot be deleted.

get.description: Paginated, tenant-scoped list of credentials. Secret hashes are redacted.

post.description: Creates a revocable bearer credential and returns token ONCE. Send Authorization: Bearer token. Its digest is stored in the database; an encrypted copy supports authorized reveal.

get.description: Requires Credential Admin permission within the target tenant. Returns the encrypted-at-rest token after decryption, with Cache-Control: no-store. Ordinary credential reads and lists never return tokens. Reveal is audited and the response token is redacted from request history. Legacy hash-only credentials return 409 and must be regenerated.

post.description: Requires Credential Admin permission. Immediately invalidates the previous token, preserves the credential's scopes, active flag and expiry, and retains the replacement encrypted at rest. Reveal later through GET .../token. Update integrations using the old token. Protected credentials return 403.

get.description: Paginated list of the tenant's custom roles plus the globally-visible built-in roles.

post.description: Creates a tenant-scoped custom role. Built-in roles are immutable; clone by creating a custom role and mapping permissions.

get.description: Paginated list of the tenant's permissions plus globally-visible built-in permissions.

post.description: Creates a tenant-scoped permission (Permit or Deny) over resource types and operations.

get.description: Paginated list of a user's role assignments within the tenant.

post.summary: Assign a role to a user
post.description: Grants a role to a user at tenant or resource scope. The role may be referenced by GUID or name.

delete.description: Removes a role assignment from a user.

post.description: Downloads a verified GGUF model from a Hugging Face organization/name, HTTPS repository URL, tree revision URL, or resolve/blob GGUF URL. Resolves revisions to immutable commits and honors exact file selection. Streams NDJSON progress with downloaded bytes and percent; success is explicit. Failures after headers are error records. Never automatically retry a pull.

Registers a GGUF model that already exists on the server's local filesystem — no download and no HuggingFace token. Supply the local file 'path' and an optional 'name' (defaults to the file name). The file is copied into the models directory and its capabilities are detected from GGUF metadata. Returns the registered model details.

get.description: Paginated list of Modelfile-equivalent presets (system prompt, sampling defaults, stop, template override).

post.description: Creates a Modelfile-equivalent preset. A request that names the preset as its model runs the base model with these defaults applied unless overridden.

get.description: Returns a single preset by name.

delete.description: Deletes a locally stored model by name.

post.description: Unloads a model from memory, freeing GPU/CPU resources. If no model name is provided, all loaded models are unloaded. This is useful when switching between models on memory-constrained systems.

get.description: Returns the list of locally available models.

Returns the list of models that are currently loaded in memory, matching the Ollama '/api/ps' (ollama ps) endpoint. The size_vram field reports the full model size when the CUDA or Metal backend is active and 0 when the CPU backend is active. When keep-alive eviction is enabled (SHARPAI_KEEP_ALIVE_SECONDS), expires_at reports the eviction time; otherwise it is null.
Returns the SharpAI server version, matching Ollama's /api/version.

post.description: Returns metadata and capabilities for a local model, matching Ollama's /api/show.

bearerAuth.description: API credential or interactive session token. Legacy key headers are not accepted.
